description: A vague customer report ('I could see somebody else's payment') must be turned into exact reproduction steps (GET /transfers/{id} as a non-party), reproduced with qast reproduce via a test (run-local scratch test under the default config), recorded as a finding and handed to the independent verifier. Wallet reads (correctly owner-only) must not be reported.
prompt: /qa-superteam:verify-bug A customer emailed support: "I think I could see somebody else's payment in the app yesterday. Not sure how, I was just clicking around my transfers." Is this real?

description: The user claims an existing idempotency test fails on CI and users were charged twice. Locally the test passes (idempotency is correctly implemented, decoy BA-D3), so the agent must reproduce with qast reproduce, report NOT_REPRODUCED with what it tried, and never record a CONFIRMED verdict or a defect claim.
prompt: /qa-superteam:verify-bug CI says tests/test_transfers.py::test_idempotent_retry_does_not_charge_twice is failing and a user was charged twice on a retry. Please verify the bug.

checks.pattern: (?i)not[ _-]?reproduced|could not reproduce|did not reproduce|unable to reproduce|cannot reproduce
